name: Line-of-sight geometry and output-record verification
purpose: Verify production ray-limit geometry, opaque-sphere guarding, and column-record layout without observational scoring.
production_capability: Initialized PIC column-integration geometry and Moon output-record callback.
configuration: Current Na spherical configuration; SPICE-dependent geometry must be supplied explicitly.
independent_reference: Closed-form sphere paths and ray-direction invariants.
units: position m; number density m^-3; column density m^-2; speed m s^-1; brightness Rayleigh where applicable
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred LSO for current production operator; fixed epoch required when SPICE is enabled.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: No particles; deterministic mesh fields and rays.
procedure: After full amps_init, call FindIntegrationLimits for four fixtures, call GetVariableList, and run the inside-origin fatal fixture in a separate process.
acceptance_criteria: Radial 2R and tangent 3R paths within 1e-12 relative; miss and reversed invariants hold; four record fields/delimiters; inside origin emits the exact production fatal diagnostic and cannot complete its receipt. The shell return code is informational because the legacy AMPS exit helper invokes MPI_Abort with error code zero.
expected_pass_result: Production LOS limits and output schema satisfy analytical/invariant checks.
status_semantics: PASS only after the callable production ray path is evaluated and the isolated inside-origin process emits the production guard; source inspection and shell status alone are not PASS.
